opportunities.title: The building blocks for a voice assistant exist
opportunities.detail: Commercial speech recognition and a synthetic voice both exist, but no major assistant understands spoken requests in this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 160 million Bengali speakers are online today, and that should reach 204 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (927 hours of transcribed speech); Shrutilipi (440 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Speech recognition makes about 50 errors per 100 words
opportunities.detail: Measured on FLEURS with a leading open model. Below about 15% is comfortably usable for dictation.
opportunities.why: About 160 million Bengali speakers are online today, and that should reach 204 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (927 hours of transcribed speech); Shrutilipi (440 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 1 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already read printed text in this language, and an open OCR model covers it.
opportunities.why: About 63 million Bengali speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 80 million within five years. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (6 billion words).

opportunities.title: Speech input is offered by 3 of 4 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already recognise this language. Open training data includes 1,768 hours of transcribed speech across 7 open datasets.
opportunities.why: About 160 million Bengali speakers are online today, and that should reach 204 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (927 hours of transcribed speech); Shrutilipi (440 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Text-to-speech is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some cloud services already have a voice for this language, and an open model can speak it.
opportunities.why: About 160 million Bengali speakers are online today, and that should reach 204 million within five years. Ready to use: MMS text-to-speech (covers this language); YODAS2 (927 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: 1 of 2 major AI assistant apps list this language
opportunities.detail: Some assistant apps already offer it. Benchmarks show models can work in it, so the gap is mainly a product decision.
